records.title: Connectome-constrained modeling identifies neurons and synapses that sustain spontaneous activity in Drosophila

decisions.notes: Preprint v1. FlyWire v783 constrains a resting-state rate model. Empirical analyses use one example head-fixed adult fly recording; n=5 independently trained models per condition are model replicates, not five animals. The first half of that recording was used for fitting and the second half held out; no independent-animal validation, nociceptive, ECAP or clinical comparator. Methods Statistical analysis reports mean +/- s.d. for model/noise replicates; there is no uncertainty estimate over independently held-out flies. Methods states no separate validation segment was held out.
